findings.explanation: “New transport can add noise with one hand and take it away with the other” reworks the fixed proverb “give with one hand and take with the other” (proposed owner 3431) by replacing give with add noise. The source conveys mixed effects, but its improvised form may not be an acceptable alias for teaching the established idiom.
findings.recommendedFix: Hold for idiomaticity/target-form review, or explicitly document the productive proverb variation and ensure future target detection/exercises do not present add noise with one hand as the canonical form.

findings.explanation: “Lower the temperature in a dispute” reduces interpersonal tension by a heat metaphor, the same sense and metaphor as canonical 727 “take the heat out of”. Different verb phrase alone does not establish a new learner outcome.
findings.recommendedFix: Hold pending canonical 727 owner-scope review, or state and support a separate construction/pragmatic use before drafting.
